section: 5/6/2026Amended by Chapter 299, 2026 General Session2026Definitions.For purposes of this part:"Unrelated business income" means unrelated business income as determined under Section 512, Internal Revenue Code."Utah unrelated business income" means the unrelated business income allocated or apportioned to Utah in accordance with Part 3, Allocation and Apportionment of Income - Utah UDITPA Provisions.
